## Identity
Roman Amangeldiyev is a computer engineering student at Bahçeşehir University and an AI product builder based in Istanbul, Türkiye. His public work includes AI products, product engineering, startup projects, and growth work.

## Olympiad awards and academic recognition
Roman Amangeldiyev has two publicly listed honors issued by the Turkmenistan Ministry of Education:

1. Sustainable Future — February 2021 — Turkmenistan Ministry of Education.
2. Programming Contest — March 2020 — Turkmenistan Ministry of Education.

These awards are presented on the canonical awards page at https://romanamangeldiyev.com/awards.html.
No medal, placement, or ranking should be inferred unless a primary source is added later.
